Method of Attack: Requesting risky permissions such as making phone calls and detecting user location
Attack Vector: Trojanized Android apps masquerading as games (simulators, platformers, arcades, RTS strategy, shooting games)
Indicators of Compromise: Approximately 9,300,000 installs across over 190 different apps
Notable trojanized apps: 快点躲起来 (Hurry up and hide), Cat adventures, Drive school simulator
